liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deal** (5 reviews): Reviewer calls this the most ripping Deal anywhere, a standout of the show; Described as huge, a first-set highlight [13][16][17][18][20]
- **Help On The Way** (3 reviews): The Help>Slip>Franklin's sequence is hot and runs about half an hour; The Help/Slip/Franklin's sequence is wonderful [11][17][19]
- **Althea** (2 reviews): Jerry and Bruce Hornsby trade strong interplay at the end of the song; Described as huge, with tremendous interplay between Jerry and Bruce [11][16]
- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): Great version, but roughly the last seven minutes are absent from this soundboard; The familiar jam after Terrapin is thoroughly engaged [14][19]
- **It Takes A Lot To Laugh It Takes A Train To Cry** (1 review): First performance of this song since 6-10-73 [12]
- **Slipknot!** (1 review): Jerry stumbles slightly at the start, but it recovers and is forgotten by Franklin's Tower [12]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight!** (1 review): After the Cal Expo shows, the reviewer especially wanted to hear a kicking Lovelight [22]

## Setlist highlights

- **C C Rider**: back after 110 archived shows (518 days) [23]
- **It Takes A Lot To Laugh It Takes A Train To Cry**: back after 1259 archived shows (6545 days); rare: 9 archived performances [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-05-12.111135.NeumannKMF4-daweez.d5scott.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 158 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1991-05-12.149700.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 169 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Somewhat oversaturated, but fuller than earlier sources [2]
- **gd1991-05-12.sbd.miller.31962.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 170 min; rated 3.65/5 by 17 [3]. Said about its sound: Both cassette sources have heavily oversaturated levels [3]
- **gd91-05-12.schoeps.oconnor.9402.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 171 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Pleasant audience recording that conveys the sound of Shoreline's reserved seating [19]
- **gd91-05-12.sbd.clugston.7362.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 153 min; rated 4.33/5 by 18 [9]. Said about its sound: Hornsby's piano playing comes through very clearly on this soundboard; The soundboard is missing much of the long post-Terrapin jam and part of Drums; Weir's guitar is clearly audible in this recording [11][14][17]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended all three Shoreline nights, sitting in the 100 sections [13]
- Reviewer attended with a brother; their short hair led people to mistake them for cops or Desert Storm soldiers [20]
- Reviewer was 19, on the tour's last show, lying on the grass as the second set wound down after Space [22]
- Reviewer rates the 5-10-91 night as the best of the three nights; this one is a close second [12]
- Some 1990 and 1987 Deals come close but none top this one; 5/10 was judged perfect [13]
- Reviewer counts this among their favorite first sets of the 1990s [16]
- Recommends the June 1989 summer solstice Shoreline show, whose Deal many consider the band's best [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-05-12.111135.NeumannKMF4-daweez.d5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: Source: 2 Neumann KMF4 microphones (15th row-center)> Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes; [1]
- **gd1991-05-12.149700.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  April 27, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]
- **gd1991-05-12.sbd.miller.31962.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat D [3]. Also: Space through The Weight patched from two cassette masters supplied by Paul Scotton, because the source DAT was noisy [3]
- **gd91-05-12.schoeps.oconnor.9402.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB-AUD:Schoeps MK4V>DAT>CDR [5]
- **gd91-05-12.sbd.clugston.7362.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Cassette > CDR [9]. Also: Reviewer patched the gaps from the audience recording, though the quality difference is stark [14]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1991-05-12 Shoreline Amphitheatre, Mountain View, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-05-12-shoreline-amphitheatre-mountain-view-ca-usa/) [24]
